 Job Description
 Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career the way you want, supported and inspired by a collaborative global community, and able to reimagine what’s possible.
Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, inclusive future.
We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to join international development team in Bucharest. The role focuses on developing first-class applications for Client businesses and clients, with approximately 70% frontend and 30% backend responsibilities. The position involves contributing across all phases of the software development life cycle within an Agile framework.
 YOUR ROLE
Plan, develop, and implement projects or parts of large-scale projects as part of the development team.
Solve complex technical and delivery challenges, from solution design to end-to-end service improvement.
Understand and evaluate complex data models.
Develop solutions that improve system performance and scalability.
Apply company development guidelines and processes, while proposing improvements where relevant.
Analyze, evaluate, and implement technical solutions for allocated projects or support areas.
Act as a mentor and technical coordinator for the development team throughout the software development life cycle.
Deliver scalable end-to-end solutions by integrating strong frontend user experience with robust backend systems.
 YOUR PROFILE
7+ years Java development experience, including frontend and backend development.
Strong experience with Spring Boot.
5+ years Angular experience
Practical knowledge in at least three of the following areas: PostgreSQL, REST / Web Services, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, Linux, and JBoss.
Daily use of development tools such as Eclipse, NetBeans, IntelliJ, SVN, Git, Mercurial, Hudson, Jenkins, Maven, JUnit, TeamCity, or FitNesse.
Experience with Web Services using WCF/SOAP and Web APIs/REST.
Knowledge of SQL, XML, JSON, and Domain Driven Design
Bachelor’s Degree: Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or Finance.
Verry good communication skills in Romanian and English
 Nice-to-Have:
Spring Data / JPA experience.
IBM Cloud knowledge.
PostgreSQL expertise.
Kafka or RabbitMQ experience.
Knowledge of vertical slice architecture
 WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE:
Flexible and dynamic work environment involving teams spread across different global locations;
Communities with shared interests and identities, all working together to advance diversity, equity and inclusion within the workplace and society;
Do you want to learn more? You will have access to various training programs and platforms (e.g.: content provided by Pluralsight, Harvard and Coursera);
Attractive benefits package (meal tickets, medical services, Benefit online, Employee Share Option Plan).
 Capgemini is an equal opportunity employer. We promote equality and dignity in all aspects of recruitment and employment, and all offers of employment and promotions are made on the basis of performance, competence and ability.
